label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is the original unescaped user parameter (baz = param) flowing directly into JavaScript output without HTML escaping. While HtmlUtils.htmlEscape() escapes param into bar, baz retains the raw user input and is used in the XSS sink at line 36. This constitutes a real XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input flows from request.getParameter() to param, then param assigned to baz (unescaped), then baz used in script tag output
